bmt-2021-calculus-tiebreaker-02.title: Factor with $\sec^2$
bmt-2021-calculus-tiebreaker-02.body:
Group: $\tan^{a+3}+\tan^{a+1}=\tan^{a+1}(\tan^2+1)=\tan^{a+1}\sec^2$ and $\tan^{a+2}+\tan^a=\tan^a\sec^2$. So the integrand is $\sec^2x\,(\tan^{a+1}x+\tan^ax)$. With $u=\tan x$, $du=\sec^2x\,dx$, the integral is $\int(u^{a+1}+u^a)\,du=\frac{u^{a+2}}{a+2}+\frac{u^{a+1}}{a+1}$.

**Answer: $\frac{\tan^{a+2}x}{a+2}+\frac{\tan^{a+1}x}{a+1}$**

bmt-2021-calculus-tiebreaker-03.title: Partial fractions
bmt-2021-calculus-tiebreaker-03.body:
$\binom{n+1}2=\frac{n(n+1)}2$, so the sum is $2\sum_{n\ge1}\frac{(-1)^{n-1}}{n(n+1)}=2\sum(-1)^{n-1}\left(\frac1n-\frac1{n+1}\right)$. Splitting, $\sum_{n\ge1}\frac{(-1)^{n-1}}n=\ln2$ and $\sum_{n\ge1}\frac{(-1)^{n-1}}{n+1}=\sum_{m\ge2}\frac{(-1)^{m}}{m}=1-\ln2$. So the sum is $2\left(\ln2-(1-\ln2)\right)=4\ln2-2$.

**Answer: $4\ln2-2$**
